notes: כֹּל אֲשֶׁר → *whatsoever* is retained as indivisible: rule 35 names this fusion, and the single word carries both the quantification and the relation. Headed on כֹּל as the governing morpheme under rule 23; heading on the relative is the named competitor.
The possessive לְ carries *hath* under rule 43 and the resumptive suffix takes nothing, the relative supplying the English subject (rule 43's closing sentence).
